title: Kourovka problem 20.52: the odd half
outcome: Odd half proved; the problem is still open
summary: |G| − k(G) = 16m is attained by an odd-order group for every m in which 2 occurs to an odd power, and for every odd m.
source: *Unsolved Problems in Group Theory. The Kourovka Notebook*, No. 21, edited by E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov, arXiv:1401.0300v50 (November 2026), problem 20.52, posed by D. MacHale.
label: lean
new: fairly sure; the proof is short
